new_analysis.ats_explanation: Core technical keywords (Python, React, Docker, PostgreSQL) are present and directly match the job description, which will pass initial ATS keyword filtering. However, the resume never explicitly states 'REST API' despite the JD requiring it, has zero quantified metrics anywhere (no percentages, user counts, latency improvements, or team size), and completely omits an education section, which most ATS parsers and recruiters flag as a red flag or auto-reject trigger for junior-to-mid engineering roles. The 3-year tenure at one company is a positive signal, but the lack of measurable product delivery evidence (explicitly required in the JD) significantly weakens interview probability despite strong keyword overlap.

missing_skills.reason: The JD explicitly lists REST APIs as a requirement. The resume only says 'Built SaaS APIs' without confirming REST architecture, so ATS keyword matching may not credit this requirement, and recruiters skimming will not confirm the skill without seeing the term explicitly.

The JD explicitly asks for 'measurable product delivery experience.' Every bullet in the resume is task-based ('Built,' 'Improved,' 'Worked on') with no numbers, so there is no evidence of impact, which recruiters use to differentiate candidates at the interview screening stage.

No education section exists anywhere in the resume. Most corporate ATS systems and recruiter screens expect at minimum a degree, bootcamp, or explicit statement of equivalent experience; its complete absence can trigger automatic disqualification or recruiter skepticism about the candidate's background.

Full stack roles requiring Docker frequently expect familiarity with cloud infrastructure or CI/CD pipelines. The resume mentions 'containerized deployment' but never names a cloud provider or pipeline tool, leaving a plausible skill gap for infrastructure-adjacent responsibilities.

strengths.title: Direct tech stack alignment
strengths.reason: Python, React, Docker, and PostgreSQL are all explicitly listed and reinforced in both experience and project sections, which directly matches 4 of the 5 core JD requirements and will register strongly in ATS keyword scans.

strengths.title: Consistent 3-year tenure

strengths.title: Project reinforces stated skills
strengths.reason: The Inventory Platform project uses the same React/Python/Docker stack as the job listing, giving recruiters a second, independent data point that the candidate has hands-on experience beyond a single employer's stack.

suggestions.reason: The JD explicitly requires 'measurable product delivery experience,' but no bullet in the resume contains a number, percentage, or scale indicator, making it impossible for a recruiter to assess actual impact versus routine task completion.
suggestions.example: Change 'Improved deploy reliability with Docker' to 'Reduced deployment failures by 30% by migrating manual deploys to Docker-based CI pipeline, cutting release time from 2 hours to 20 minutes.'
suggestions.impact: Quantified metrics directly address the JD's stated requirement and are the single highest-leverage change for increasing recruiter callback rate on this resume.

suggestions.reason: The resume never uses the exact phrase 'REST API,' which is a named requirement in the job description; ATS systems commonly perform exact or near-exact keyword matching, so an implied skill may not register as a match.
suggestions.example: Change 'Built SaaS APIs and dashboards' to 'Designed and built RESTful APIs (Python/Flask or FastAPI) powering SaaS dashboards consumed by [X] internal/external users.'
suggestions.impact: Improves ATS keyword match rate for a JD-required term and gives recruiters explicit confirmation of REST API design experience.

suggestions.reason: There is no education section in the resume, which is unusual and can cause both ATS parsing errors (some systems expect a degree field) and recruiter hesitation about verifying baseline qualifications.
suggestions.example: Add a section: 'Education: B.S. in Computer Science, [University Name], [Year]' or, if no formal degree exists, state 'Self-taught engineer with [X] years professional experience; completed [specific bootcamp/certification] in [year].'
suggestions.impact: Removes a common automatic disqualification trigger in corporate ATS filters and closes a credibility gap for recruiters screening the resume.

suggestions.reason: The summary is generic ('experience building SaaS products') and does not mention any of the JD's named technologies or years of experience, reducing its effectiveness as an ATS keyword anchor and recruiter first-impression tool.
suggestions.example: Replace with: 'Full Stack Engineer with 3 years of experience building SaaS products using Python, React, Docker, and PostgreSQL, with hands-on ownership of API development and containerized deployments.'
suggestions.impact: A keyword-dense, specific summary improves ATS ranking and gives recruiters an immediate skills match in the first 5 seconds of resume review.
